items.title: Meaning of 'Athithi Devo Bhava'
items.explanation: 'Athithi Devo Bhava' translates to 'The guest is a god.' It means that guests are treated with great respect and honor, similar to deities. This concept emphasizes the importance of politeness and kindness when welcoming others into your home.

items.title: Importance of Politeness to Guests
items.explanation: Being polite to guests is crucial because it shows respect for their presence and well-being. It helps build positive relationships, ensures they feel comfortable, and reflects the moral value of kindness in social interactions.
